from primitive_api import (
    get_task_context,
    inspect_current_view,
    scan_scene,
    check_progress_public,
)

ctx = get_task_context()
print("Context:", ctx)

view = inspect_current_view(label="init_view", remember=True)

scan = scan_scene(
    queries=["RemoteControl", "Remote", "Dresser", "SideTable", "TissueBox", "FloorLamp", "DeskLamp", "Lamp"],
    rotations=4,
    include_tilts=True,
    remember=True,
)
print("Scan query hits:", {k: [o.get("objectId") for o in v] for k, v in scan.get("query_hits", {}).items()})
print("Progress:", check_progress_public())

from primitive_api import (
    move_ahead,
    look,
    observe,
    detect_objects,
    get_frame,
    check_progress_public,
)

# Look up once to horizontal (0 deg) or keep at 30 deg, and move ahead toward the brown dresser in front of us.
for i in range(4):
    res = move_ahead()
    obs = observe()
    vis = detect_objects()
    print(f"Step {i+1}: move_ahead ->", getattr(res, "ok", res), "pose:", obs.get("agent"), "visible count:", len(vis))
    if vis:
        print("Visible objects:", [(o.get("objectType"), o.get("objectId"), o.get("distance")) for o in vis])
        break

# If still nothing visible, try looking up
if not detect_objects():
    look("up")
    vis = detect_objects()
    print("After look up visible:", [(o.get("objectType"), o.get("objectId"), o.get("distance")) for o in vis])

get_frame("after_move_to_dresser")
print("Progress:", check_progress_public())

from primitive_api import (
    move_ahead,
    look,
    rotate,
    observe,
    detect_objects,
    remember_visible_objects,
    get_frame,
    check_progress_public,
)

# Move closer to the dresser and look up to see the objects on top of the dresser (z ~ 4.3-4.6, y ~ 1.1)
for i in range(4):
    res = move_ahead()
    obs = observe()
    print(f"Move {i+1}: lastActionSuccess={obs.get('lastActionSuccess')}, pos={obs.get('agent', {}).get('position')}")
    if not obs.get("lastActionSuccess"):
        break

# Look up so cameraHorizon is 0
look("up")
obs = observe()
print("After look up, horizon:", obs.get("agent", {}).get("cameraHorizon"))
vis = detect_objects()
print("Visible at horizon 0:", [(o.get("objectType"), o.get("objectId"), round(o.get("distance", 0), 2), o.get("position")) for o in vis])
remember_visible_objects(label="at_dresser_h0")

# Also check if we need to step left (towards x = -3.85 where the middle of the dresser is)
# Let's see what is visible first; if RemoteControl isn't visible yet, rotate left, move ahead, rotate right.
remotes = [o for o in vis if "Remote" in o.get("objectType", "")]
lamps = [o for o in vis if "Lamp" in o.get("objectType", "")]
print("Remotes visible:", remotes)
print("Lamps visible:", lamps)

if not remotes:
    rotate("left")
    move_ahead()
    move_ahead()
    rotate("right")
    vis2 = detect_objects()
    print("Visible after stepping left:", [(o.get("objectType"), o.get("objectId"), round(o.get("distance", 0), 2), o.get("position")) for o in vis2])
    remember_visible_objects(label="at_dresser_left_h0")
    # Also check horizon 30
    look("down")
    vis3 = detect_objects()
    print("Visible after stepping left (h30):", [(o.get("objectType"), o.get("objectId"), round(o.get("distance", 0), 2)) for o in vis3])
    remember_visible_objects(label="at_dresser_left_h30")

get_frame("dresser_closeup")
print("Progress:", check_progress_public())

# Let's check what happens if we pick up RemoteControl|-04.18|+01.11|+04.79 first, or look around x=-3.54.
# Wait: right now we are at x=-3.75, z=3.75, facing z+ (0 deg).
# Let's see all visible objects right now:
vis = detect_objects()
print("Currently visible:", [(o.get("objectType"), o.get("objectId"), o.get("distance")) for o in vis])

# Let's pick up RemoteControl|-04.18|+01.11|+04.79

# Look at official steps:
# "Turn to the left and then right to the brown dresser."
# "Pick up the remote from the middle of the dresser, directly behind the tissues."
# "Hold the remote and move a step to the left."
# "Hold the remote and turn on the lamp."
# Let's check what is to the left of the dresser or on the left side of the dresser!
rotate("left")

look("up")
vis_left_h0 = detect_objects()
print("Visible facing left h0:", [(o.get("objectType"), o.get("objectId"), o.get("distance"), o.get("isToggled")) for o in vis_left_h0])

get_frame("facing_left_with_remote")
print("Check success:", check_success())

from primitive_api import (
    move_ahead,
    rotate,
    look,
    detect_objects,
    toggle_object,
    check_success,
    check_progress_public,
    get_frame,
)

# Move a step to the left (we are already facing left / 270 deg), then turn right (back toward the dresser) to see the lamp on the left side of the dresser!
move_ahead()
move_ahead()
rotate("right")

vis = detect_objects()
print("Visible at h0:", [(o.get("objectType"), o.get("objectId"), o.get("distance"), o.get("isToggled")) for o in vis])

lamps = [o for o in vis if "Lamp" in o.get("objectType", "")]
if not lamps:
    look("down")
    vis = detect_objects()
    print("Visible at h15:", [(o.get("objectType"), o.get("objectId"), o.get("distance"), o.get("isToggled")) for o in vis])
    lamps = [o for o in vis if "Lamp" in o.get("objectType", "")]

if lamps:
    lamp_id = lamps[0]["objectId"]
    res_tog = toggle_object(lamp_id, on=True)
    print("Toggle lamp result:", getattr(res_tog, "ok", res_tog))

get_frame("after_toggle_lamp")
print("Check success:", check_success())
print("Progress:", check_progress_public())

from primitive_api import (
    rotate,
    move_ahead,
    look,
    detect_objects,
    toggle_object,
    check_success,
    check_progress_public,
    get_frame,
)

# In frame facing_left_with_remote_912de3bfce.png, we see the lamp on the far left of the dresser!
# Move one more step left so we are in front of that lamp, then turn right and toggle it on.
rotate("left")
move_ahead()
move_ahead()
rotate("right")

vis = detect_objects()
print("Visible at h15:", [(o.get("objectType"), o.get("objectId"), o.get("distance"), o.get("isToggled")) for o in vis])

lamps = [o for o in vis if "Lamp" in o.get("objectType", "")]
if not lamps:
    look("up")
    vis = detect_objects()
    print("Visible at h0:", [(o.get("objectType"), o.get("objectId"), o.get("distance"), o.get("isToggled")) for o in vis])
    lamps = [o for o in vis if "Lamp" in o.get("objectType", "")]

if lamps:
    for lamp in lamps:
        print("Toggling lamp:", lamp["objectId"])
        res_tog = toggle_object(lamp["objectId"], on=True)
        print("Toggle result:", getattr(res_tog, "ok", res_tog))
        if check_success().get("success"):
            break

get_frame("lamp_toggled")
print("Check success:", check_success())
print("Progress:", check_progress_public())
